results.title: Supreme Court registers petition challenging removal of Nepal Police chief
results.content: Dan Bahadur Karki has asked the court to overturn the Cabinet decision appointing Manoj Kumar KC as police chief, arguing that his removal before the end of his tenure violated due process.

results.title: Passengers to get live view of baggage handling at Kathmandu airport
results.content: Screens in the arrival hall will show luggage being unloaded from aircraft, giving passengers a better idea of when their bags will reach the baggage carousel.

results.title: Nepal sets up round-the-clock centre to combat online financial scams
results.content: Police, banks, payment firms and telecom operators will work under one roof to trace stolen funds, freeze accounts and disable the digital infrastructure used by fraudsters.

results.title: Nepal’s remaining Bhutanese refugees seek legal recognition
results.content: Three decades after fleeing Bhutan, refugees languishing in Jhapa and Morang remain unable to access jobs, banking, and professional opportunities, while repatriation and family reunification remain unresolved.

results.title: Reconstruction aid, strategic ties, pending disputes on PM’s India visit agenda
results.content: Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s proposed four-day visit starting November 22 comes at a critical juncture in Nepal-India relations. Kathmandu is seeking billions in aid for post-flood recovery, air connectivity, and progress on stalled projects.

results.title: Beyond sushi and sukiyaki, a taste of Japanese culture in Kathmandu
results.content: The week-long Japanese Food Festival goes beyond authentic cuisine, introducing diners to the etiquette and traditions behind the food.

results.title: Kathmandu cruise to nine-wicket win over Biratnagar, climb to second
results.content: A disciplined bowling display restricted Biratnagar to 83 before David Warner and Will Bosisto guided Kathmandu to victory in just 9.4 overs.

results.title: Claims of TU land recovery spark controversy amid ongoing encroachments
results.content: Education Minister Sasmit Pokharel says over 35 hectares of land have been recovered in Kathmandu Valley, but university employees and professors say no land has actually been handed back.

results.title: Kathmandu Valley braces for another season of air pollution
results.content: Several places recorded unhealthy air quality on Thursday morning.

results.title: What happens when the police are the problem?
results.content: The removal of Nepal’s police chief has renewed questions about police independence. Accountability must extend beyond the institution.

results.title: Journalists raise alarm over police intervention and proposed media laws
results.content: The Federation of Nepali Journalists has questioned the government’s approach to the media, citing police raids on newsrooms, pressure on journalists and proposed legislation it says could undermine constitutional guarantees of press freedom.

results.title: WTO flags Nepal’s weak manufacturing base and narrow export markets
results.content: The country’s narrow export base, weak manufacturing capacity, high trade costs, and infrastructure bottlenecks continue to constrain its integration into global markets.

results.title: Why the NPL can turn Nepal’s promises into wins
results.content: Close losses to South Africa and England show what is missing. The league, and a home qualifier in December, offer a chance to fix it.

results.title: Nepali Congress alleges surveillance around Gagan Thapa amid arrest rumours
results.content: Plainclothes police have allegedly monitored Thapa’s home and office, fuelling speculation of a possible arrest.

results.title: How’s BP Koirala tweeting? We asked the man behind it
results.content: A decade ago, a Twitter account began sharing the words of BP Koirala, bringing the thoughts of Nepal’s first democratically elected prime minister into today’s political conversations.

results.title: Police summon Congress leader Ajaya Babu Shiwakoti
results.content: The party’s joint general secretary says he will return to Kathmandu to appear before the Cyber Bureau, accusing the government of trying to rule through intimidation.

results.title: Nearly 10 million Nepali children exposed to unhealthy air, UNICEF warns
results.content: Millions more face drought, extreme heat and landslides, with overlapping climate and environmental hazards threatening children's health, education and protection, a new report says.

results.title: Abhishek Bastola to play Australia Open Asia-Pacific Wildcard Playoff
results.content: Bastola, who has represented Nepal in four Asian Games, is the first Nepali to play in the tournament.

results.title: ‘Max Sports Summit 2026’ to bring players, investors and policymakers together
results.content: Australian cricket star David Warner will join Nepali and international sporting figures at the Friday event in Kathmandu to discuss investment, governance, infrastructure and players’ welfare.

results.title: Saudi firm to pay 181,000 riyals to family of Nepali killed in drone strike
results.content: The company has agreed to pay 31,000 riyals as end-of-service benefits and 150,000 riyals as compensation to Bharat Mahato’s family, equivalent to over Rs7.2 million, Nepali embassy says.

results.title: In Kathmandu, Misri discusses potential agenda for PM Shah’s India visit
results.content: In courtesy meetings and bilateral consultation, both sides discuss economic assistance, status of India-funded projects and energy cooperation.
